name: Nanjing Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Securities Co., Ltd. provides securities finance and other related services in China. It operates through Securities and Futures Brokerage Business; Securities Investment Business; Investment Banking; and Asset Management and Investment Management Business segments. The company offers securities agency trading, futures IB, margin trading, agreed repurchase and stock pledged repurchase, and commodity and financial futures brokerage businesses.
